name: WOWII Conjecture 181 (formalized square-degree reading): counterexample and formal certificate
body:
## Summary

This release records an apparently unrecorded counterexample to the explicitly
formalized **square-degree reading** of Written on the Wall II Conjecture 181,
together with a no-`sorry` Lean 4 certificate and independent exact verifier.

It does not claim that `T(7)` refutes the alternative reading that measures the
same square-periphery vertices' degrees back in the original graph: that
reading holds on the witness with slack 9.

## Counterexample

Let `G=T(7)=L(K7)`, the 21-vertex triangular graph. Exact certification gives

- `alpha(G)=3`;
- `b(G)=6`;
- `gamma_c(G)=5`, hence `Ls(G)=16`;
- `G^2=K21`, so `B(G^2)=V` and its average degree in `G^2` is `20`.

The formalized reading falsely requires

`Ls+b = 16+6 = 22 >= 23 = 3+20 = alpha+deg_avg(B(G^2))`.

If degrees are measured back in `G`, the RHS is `3+10=13`, so the inequality
holds with slack 9 and this is not a counterexample to that parse.

## Relationship to the C5[K4] campaign

The carrier family repeatedly saturated the 181 wall while satisfying
`alpha=lambda_max`. The method identified that identity as the obstruction and
moved to triangular graphs, where ordinary independence separates from local
independence while the neighboring `Ls+b` bounds remain tight. `T(6)` is tight;
`T(7)` crosses.

## Immutable artifacts

- [Reading/status/priority audit](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/eaaf8b70036eb65c47942b57a31322492ff5b9d5/results/expansion/wowii_181_formalized_reading_audit.md)
- [Independent exact verifier](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/8f4bad087fa543ac9b2eac7622241c0bbbac5e56/scripts/verify_wowii_181.py)
- [Invariant-wall navigation method](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/b001771f367e1de30099e9afee34157b73a47dd5/METHOD.md)

## Complete formal certificate

The [complete no-`sorry` Lean certificate](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/3bfa33d7470055a9a11d9ffde29186245dc3a329/lean/GraphConjecture181.lean)
compiles warning-clean. Its trust assumptions are `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Lean.ofReduceBool`, `Lean.trustCompiler`, and `Quot.sound`;
there is no `sorryAx` or project-specific axiom.

## Reading and priority note

The linked source definitions make square-degree measurement natural and it is
the reading selected by the campaign's tightness gate, but the historical
notation does not uniquely specify the ambient graph for the degree average.
The release therefore remains explicitly reading-qualified.

No earlier independent resolution of this parse was located in the targeted
audit. The result was already public in this project's 2026-08-12 commit and
upstream issue/PR before this packaging release; “apparently unrecorded” is a
dated, search-limited conclusion, not absolute priority.

## AI assistance disclosure

OpenAI Codex and delegated coding agents assisted with source interpretation,
proof development, independent verification, priority research, and release
preparation. The submitter reviewed the statement, reading caveat,
counterexample, Lean artifact, and attribution and takes responsibility for
this release.

name: WOWII Conjecture 430a: counterexample and formal certificate
body:
## Summary

This release records an apparently unrecorded infinite counterexample family
for Written on the Wall II Conjecture 430a, with a no-`sorry` Lean 4
certificate and independent exact verification.

The result is the second qualitatively different prospective transfer produced
by the invariant-wall navigation method.

## Counterexample

Replace the seven vertices of `P7` by cliques of orders

`(1,4,12,19,12,4,1)`

and completely join consecutive cliques. The 53-vertex graph has

- independent domination number `i = 3`;
- center-neighborhood independence number `2`, under both open and closed
  readings;
- `CW = 51123/25585 = 2 - 47/25585 < 2`.

Thus `floor(CW - 1) = 0`, and the conjecture falsely asserts `3 <= 2`.
Uniformly scaling every clique order preserves the relevant quotient
invariants and Caro-Wei sum, yielding an infinite counterexample family.

## Relationship to the C5[K4] campaign

Regular dense carriers make the center equal all vertices, so the
center-neighborhood term absorbs independent domination. The method isolated
that obstruction and introduced controlled eccentricity asymmetry with a
nonuniform path blow-up, while keeping the Caro-Wei value just below its next
integer cliff. This transfer lies outside the earlier `Ls+b` cluster.

## Immutable artifacts

- [Derivation, source/readings audit, and novelty record](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/8d48fbdf45301afb57f9d4d5627f5b984f385089/results/expansion/wowii_430a_disproof.md)
- [Independent exact verifier](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/8d48fbdf45301afb57f9d4d5627f5b984f385089/scripts/verify_wowii_430a.py)
- [Invariant-wall navigation method](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/b001771f367e1de30099e9afee34157b73a47dd5/METHOD.md)

## Complete formal certificate

The [complete no-`sorry` Lean certificate](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/85fff48cdd7cc1f743802320fdc94db14d1f841e/lean/GraphConjecture430a.lean)
compiles warning-clean. Its trust assumptions are `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Lean.ofReduceBool`, `Lean.trustCompiler`, and `Quot.sound`;
there is no `sorryAx` or project-specific axiom.

## Reading and priority note

Both the open- and closed-neighborhood readings of `N(C)` give independence
number two on this graph. Exact searches found no positive-integer `P7`
clique-blow-up witness below order 53; that is minimality only within this
construction class, not global order-minimality.

Targeted searches found no earlier resolution. “Apparently unrecorded” is a
dated search conclusion, not absolute bibliographic priority.

name: WOWII Conjecture 176: counterexample and formal certificate
body:
## Summary

This release records an apparently unrecorded counterexample family for
Written on the Wall II Conjecture 176, with a no-`sorry` Lean 4 certificate
and an independent exact verifier.

## Counterexample

Let `D_7` be two triangles whose distinguished vertices are joined by a path
of seven edges. The certified values are

- `Ls(D_7) <= 4`;
- `b(D_7) = 10`;
- `dist_D_7(M(D_7^2)) = 5`.

The source reading would require `Ls + b >= n + dist`, hence `14 >= 15`.
If the final distance is instead measured in `D_7^2`, it is `3`, and the
alternative reading still requires `14 >= 15`.

More generally, the family `D_L` crosses the published reading for every
`L >= 5` and both readings for every `L >= 7`.

## Relationship to the C5[K4] campaign

The carrier's equality geometry exposed a shared theorem baseline that makes
diameter-two crossing impossible. Leaving that regime while retaining a small
maximum-leaf number led prospectively to the barbell family `D_L` and this
counterexample.

## Immutable artifacts

- [Derivation, source/readings audit, and novelty record](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/9bfc0586e7afcf3708aea5fe878346d72e266196/results/expansion/wowii_176_disproof.md)
- [Independent exact verifier](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/9bfc0586e7afcf3708aea5fe878346d72e266196/scripts/verify_wowii_176.py)
- [Invariant-wall navigation method](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/b001771f367e1de30099e9afee34157b73a47dd5/METHOD.md)

## Complete formal certificate

The [complete no-`sorry` Lean certificate](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/b0ba2b9206176b4fc30bd633de206ac230b4e01f/lean/GraphConjecture176.lean)
compiles warning-clean. Its trust assumptions are `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Lean.ofReduceBool`, `Lean.trustCompiler`, and `Quot.sound`;
there is no `sorryAx` or project-specific axiom.

## Reading and priority note

The source definitions select `M(G^2)` in the square and measure its minimum
distance back in `G`. The same `D_7` witness also refutes the natural all-in-
`G^2` interpretation, so the disproof does not depend on resolving that
notation ambiguity.

Targeted searches found no earlier resolution. “Apparently unrecorded” is a
dated search conclusion, not absolute bibliographic priority.

name: WOWII Conjecture 172: counterexample and formal certificate
body:
## Summary

This release records an apparently unrecorded counterexample family for
Written on the Wall II Conjecture 172, together with a no-`sorry` Lean 4
certificate and an independent exact verifier.

Under the source-faithful reading

`Ls(G) >= -1 + Delta(B(G)) + dist_min(G, M(G^2))`,

the conjecture is false.

## Counterexample

Let `D_9` be two triangles whose distinguished vertices are joined by a path
of nine edges. The formally certified bounds and values are:

- `Ls(D_9) <= 4`;
- the peripheral vertices have maximum original-graph degree `2`;
- `M(D_9^2) = {p_1, p_8}`;
- `dist_D_9(p_1,p_8) = 7`.

The conjecture would imply `4 >= -1 + 2 + 7 = 8`. Measuring the final
distance in `D_9^2` instead gives `4`, and the alternative reading still fails:
`4 >= -1 + 2 + 4 = 5`.

## Relationship to the C5[K4] campaign

The `C5[K4]` carrier exposed repeated exact `Ls` walls. Theorem subtraction
showed that diameter-two movement could not cross the relevant baseline, so
the method deliberately left diameter two. The resulting two-triangles-and-a-
path family first crossed Conjecture 176 and then this adjacent wall.

## Immutable artifacts

- [Derivation, source audit, and novelty record](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/bf10abe232b96d98db895a879d25a1343ccd5c77/results/expansion/wowii_172_disproof.md)
- [Independent exact verifier](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/bf10abe232b96d98db895a879d25a1343ccd5c77/scripts/verify_wowii_176.py)
- [Invariant-wall navigation method](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/b001771f367e1de30099e9afee34157b73a47dd5/METHOD.md)

## Complete formal certificate

The [complete no-`sorry` Lean certificate](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/c5-k4/blob/a948106ad2d2a5d291b6b99575fe78bf373e7e02/lean/GraphConjecture172.lean)
compiles with warnings as errors. Its trust assumptions are `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Lean.ofReduceBool`, `Lean.trustCompiler`, and `Quot.sound`;
there is no `sorryAx` or project-specific axiom.

## Reading and priority note

`Delta(B)` uses original-graph degrees among peripheral vertices, and the
source definition measures `dist_min(M(G^2))` back in `G`. The witness also
fails the natural all-in-`G^2` reading.

Targeted searches found no earlier resolution. “Apparently unrecorded” is a
dated search conclusion, not a claim of absolute bibliographic priority.
